title: I'm Surprised at How Well this Interview Went.
subtitle: It's about the rapid anti-suicidal effects of SWIFT TMS.
body_html:
This was a good interview. I review the data on SWIFT TMS (a trial I was an investigator on) and its recent re-analysis regarding rapidity of suicidal symptoms relief.1.

The video is better than I expected.

I have a multi-part article on the Lindsay Clancy case coming up soon. We also have exciting coverage regarding RAMHT New Orleans on September 14th.

There is a psychedelic open comment period that same day!
